zh.title: 臺灣國防部通報偵獲1架共機及9艘共艦 國軍監控應處
zh.summary: 臺灣國防部通報1架共機及9艘共艦；共機侵擾東部空域，國軍監控應處
body: 國防部表示，統計自11月24日上午6時起至25日上午6時的24小時期間，偵獲1架中國軍機侵擾臺灣東部空域，另偵獲9艘中國軍艦。
國防部指出，國軍運用任務機艦及岸置飛彈系統，對相關共機與共艦動態嚴密監控與應處。
本站統計紀錄顯示，前一次紀錄為11月24日，當時共機3架次、共艦9艘；近7日共3筆紀錄，平均每天為共機8.3架次、共艦10.7艘。

en.title: Taiwan defense ministry reports one Chinese military aircraft and nine warships
en.summary: Taiwan's defense ministry reports one Chinese military aircraft east of Taiwan and nine warships; forces monitored activity.
body: Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense said it detected one Chinese military aircraft in airspace east of Taiwan during the 24 hours from 6 a.m. on Nov. 24 to 6 a.m. on Nov. 25. It also reported detecting nine Chinese warships during the same period.
The ministry said Taiwan's armed forces used tasked aircraft and vessels, as well as shore-based missile systems, to closely monitor and respond to the activity.

SKYTICAL's statistical records show that the previous record, dated Nov. 24, listed three Chinese military aircraft sorties and nine warships. Its recent seven-day data contain three records, with daily averages of 8.3 aircraft sorties and 10.7 warships.
